name: outsider-art
title_zh: 拒绝渐变和噪点的扁平插画，每块色都带手作纸纹
tagline_zh: 大块平涂色区，每区一种手工纹理（窗格点阵、缝线虚线、织纹颗粒、墨线轮廓），撒满做日常事的无脸小人。纸白、暖墨黑、2–4 个场景色，外加恰好一个饱和高亮色。
tagline_en: Large flat color zones each carrying one hand-made texture, tiny faceless silhouette figures doing ordinary things; paper white, warm ink black, 2–4 scene colors plus exactly one saturated highlight.
desc_en: Large flat color zones each carrying one hand-made texture, tiny faceless silhouette figures doing ordinary things; paper white, warm ink black, 2–4 scene colors plus exactly one saturated highlight.
why_zh: 那「恰好一个高亮色」必须真的在构图里干活，不是点缀——它把民间艺术的天真感变成了可执行的约束。
why_en: That single highlight must do real compositional work — it turns folk-art naivety into an executable constraint.
limit_zh: 小人是实心剪影、无脸、不许是火柴人——作者反复强调。照片只当语义参考，不复制细节。仓里 3 个 SKILL.md，这件是 outsider-art。
limit_en: Figures are solid silhouettes, faceless, never stick figures. The photo is a semantic reference only. One of three skills in the repo.
title_en: Flat illustration with hand-made paper texture, no gradients
